items.title: 52060_Eddie Barefield oral history interview
items.q: Jimmy Rushing was sitting on the bandstand with white socks on

ctx.x: Well, I went down there with Benny Moten's band. We traveled all through -- in fact, that was our stomping ground, Texas, Oklahoma and Arkansas, Little Rock, Arkansas, and I went down there with Fletcher, and, well, you know, you just know where to go and where to stay.

I remember one time Benny Moten's band played at Beaumont, Texas, and Jimmy Rushing was sitting on the bandstand with white socks on, and a guy walked up there and pulled out his gun and said, 'Nigger, take those white socks off.'
